bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("fs");let roots=fs.readdirSync("/tmp").filter(n=>n.startsWith("real-teaching-"));let records=[];function scan(p,d){if(d>5)return;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(p,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p+"/"+e.name;if(e.isDirectory())scan(f,d+1);else if(e.name.endsWith(".json")){try{let x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"));let turns=Array.isArray(x.turns)?x.turns:[];for(let t of turns)if(t.teaching)records.push({state:t.state,error:t.error,stages:t.teaching.stages?.map(s=>({phase:s.phase,state:s.state,error:s.error,cost:s.cost})),verdict:t.teaching.verdict,cost:t.teaching.cost_usd})}catch{}}}}for(let n of roots)scan("/tmp/"+n,0);console.log(JSON.stringify({probe_directories:roots.length,records}));'
